_comment: Path prefix -> GitHub handles to request review from, used by
Keys are PATH PREFIXES, not globs: a rule matches when a changed file's path
starts with the key. Rules are ADDITIVE -- a PR touching gnovm/ and tm2/ asks
both sets. This is deliberately unlike CODEOWNERS, where the last matching
pattern wins and the earlier owners are never asked.
More specific prefixes simply add to the broader ones: a gnoweb change is also
a gno.land change, so it asks alexiscolin AND moul.
The PR author is always removed before requesting.
